notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Note: QoL And Accessibility Changes
notes.content: [p]Keybinding for rotating and flipping augments will not be in this patch, unfortunately, but it's a planned change, so please be patient.[/p][h2]QoL and Accessibility Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added an explanation of multiple input augments in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Lasers now render with the correct width.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the clarity of explosions and lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added settings for screenshake and lighting intensity.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the lighting of decoration objects on the walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller binding now correctly displays its icon.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Note: Major Balance Changes
notes.content: [p]Everyone has sent very amazing suggestions and feedback lately. I cannot yet implement all the improvements that I wanted to, but I'm pushing this patch either way because a lot of people want these changes.[/p][h2]Game Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Durability has been [b]REMOVED[/b] as this has been requested by multiple people. I'm also reducing the number of chests in each room so players can't get too strong too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Player movement speed has been slightly increased, and the fire rate is now much faster. This change is intended to improve the game pacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Health and Shield drop rates have been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Chests will drop more items of their tier.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock packages are now a bit cheaper.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Augments with shot-counting properties should now count properly. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the tutorial would lock the player when teaching artifact activation. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller drifting detection. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Note: Featuring Local Co-op Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, first of all, I wanted to thank everyone who has supported the game so far. You've sent me various feedback to improve the game, and I really appreciate it.
Anyways, here's a list of what is included in this patch:
[h2]Local Co-op[/h2]
[list]
[*] Each player now has a different cursor outline
[*] Defeating bosses will now drop one upgrade for each player.
[/list]
Online multiplayer still has issues and will remain in Beta, but I'm working on it.
[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Durability is now less punishing
[*] Potions now fill up faster
[*] Damage over the display limit is displayed with better clarity
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game will now be able to load saved games with orbitting items.
[*] Fixed issues regarding potion effects causing persistence buff when restarting the game.
[*] Artifacts will now properly reset, preventing persistence buff.
[*] Fixed a bug where dying to the Rune Wall would leave a permanent blockage where the boss is.
[*] Reduced memory leak, preventing lag spikes (this may still happen, please report to me if so).
[*] Fixed issue where amethyst shards are not saved.
[*] Fixed an issue where charging augments don't interact properly with "number of shots" augments.
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial Hotfix
notes.content:
Some people are experiencing a bug in the tutorial that prevents them from progressing the tutorial.
If this happens to you, try updating the game.
Or if you cannot update the game for some reason, you can bypass the bugged part by using WASD and E in the inventory to move the items instead.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.10.16 Bug Fixes And QoL Changes.
notes.content:
[p]This patch introduces multiple quality of life changes as well as some major bug fixes.[/p][h2]Quality of life changes[/h2][list][*][p]Added damage number to tell you how much damage you're dealing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added display settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Better controller support.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]The shopkeeper will now tell what an item does.[/p][/*][*][p]More music tracks for each map have been added.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Creating an infinite loop gun will no longer crash the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Binding selection key will no longer instantly ask for rebind.[/p][/*][*][p]Wall hitboxes are now grouped, preventing the player from getting stuck while sliding.[/p][/*][*][p]Sound effects have diminishing returns, preventing loud noises when playing multiple sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer move the gun core (If this somehow still happens please tell me).[/p][/*][/list][p]If you find more bugs or have any feedback, please feel free to report via the Discord Server:

notes.title: Patch 0.9.15 Demo pathfinding fix.
notes.content: [h2]A quick fix for the pathfinding algorithm.[/h2][p]This is a quick fix to some of the pathfinding bugs:[/p][list][*][p]The pathfinding algorithm now properly links nodes and no longer forces enemies to get stuck trying to phase through walls.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The enemies' AI now tries to dodge small obstacles to prevent getting stuck on them. This is still not perfect, so sometimes they can still get stuck if the objects are too clumped up, but it's now way less common.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.9.11 Demo is LIVE with Online Coop BETA + Official Discord Server
notes.content:
[h1]OFFICIAL DISCORD SERVER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/a87839802aafe35a4bd1064245a8943bb405bc11.png[/img]
Link to the Discord Server: [url=https://discord.gg/ugXPWrtqzP]https://discord.gg/ugXPWrtqzP[/url]
Join the server and maybe find some friends to play Online Coop.
Also, you can send me feedback and help me develop the game there.
[h1]ONLINE COOP BETA[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/b4965feb7a1047d9e01ff86950771d6323b880c5.png[/img]
Online Coop has been improved by a lot with lots of bug fixes.
The color of the bullet now correctly displays on the client side.
Lasers can now be seen on the client side.
The map now updates properly when the server uses the minimap to teleport.
If the client side doesn't catch an object deletion data, it will now try to check if the server still has the object and delete the object if necessary, removing unnecessary object clutters on screen.
[h1]HOW TO HOST A LOBBY[/h1]
To host a server so your friends can join.
First, enter the multiplayer hub found in the bottom right corner of the home map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/7dccf07b4bc6ca459e5019b9509134ab3a031761.png[/img]
In there, you'll find the Create Lobby button at the top right corner of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/59746f5fdef35dec613028edd875185ba25a2c08.png[/img]
You can wether create a Local Server by clicking Create LAN or you can create an Online Server via Steam Relay by clicking Create Relay. If you create a relay server, you need to click copy to copy the Relay ID and send it to your friends. Then you can click Back and press Space to create your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/3519b4cd26e6c53934eb2288db683bd4611ea564.png[/img]
[h1]HOW TO JOIN A LOBBY[/h1]
To join your friend's server.
Enter the multiplayer hub found in the bottom right corner of the home map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/7dccf07b4bc6ca459e5019b9509134ab3a031761.png[/img]
Go to Join Lobby at the top right corner of the screen below Create Lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/59746f5fdef35dec613028edd875185ba25a2c08.png[/img]
To join a Local Server you can just click Join LAN. But if you want to join an Online Server you need to copy the Relay ID your friend sent you and click Paste to paste the ID and click on Join Relay. Then you can click Back and press Space to create your character.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/ad65859cb58f2e28ba10732ad1519e2339594860.png[/img]
It's currently in BETA so there's still a lot of work to do please stay tuned for upcoming patches.

[b]NOTE: The desert area will be removed from the Demo in the upcoming update revamping bosses and enemies to ensure I'm not leaking too much of the main game. So this is your last chance to try the area.[/b]

notes.title: Meowmunitions Demo 0.9.0 is LIVE
notes.content:
[h1]NEW FEATURE: ARTIFACTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/01a1a4c6b318bce750ac9d22aede6d79db375ad2.png[/img]
Artifacts is a cool new addition to the game. You can equip them in your inventory, separated from the augments and they will give you passive abilities, ranging from stats boost to game breaking.
[h1]NEW AUGMENTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/84804180c885c272caace989ef1c472081d8490a.png[/img]
There are over 30 new augments that were added in this update.
Chests have also been improved to give you a better chance of getting different augments and enrich your synergies.
Also, you can now flip augments over, allowing you to further customize your gun!
[h1]A BUILT-IN WIKI[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832158/b1a4caf8fb0550193e565aa521fb530da287cd57.png[/img]
A new built-in wiki has been added to help you determine what this augment or artifact can do.

[b]Final note: [/b]I have decided to add a whole new map to the prologue coming next update so stay tuned as it is coming very soon <3
